title: Revoked or expired grant accepted
description: Synthetic case: delegation was revoked or its validity window elapsed before request.
policy_assumptions: Delegation was revoked before request time.
Requests after revocation must not use the old grant unless an explicit grandfathering rule applies.

expected.rationale: A revoked or expired delegation is not valid authority.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
